newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Feb 12.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices were quoted lower on Wednesday with more offers than bids, traders said. Quotes were far apart, though spreads between 180-cst and 380-cst narrowed slightly from Tuesday. Traders said bids were scarce as shipowners were anticipating bunker prices to ease further as crude falls, placing more pressure on prices.
